technical_and_design_decisions: Target Java 17+ and Spring Framework 6.0+ as per the specification.
Implement the runtime info shell command using Spring Shell.
Implement YARN deployment using the Spring Cloud Deployer SPI for YARN.
Refactor the build lifecycle using Maven multi-module reactor and profiles to bundle SPI deployers individually.
Replace XDRuntimeException with standard Spring or Spring Cloud Data Flow specific exceptions.
Package SFTP source as an OOTB Spring Cloud Stream module and publish to the Maven repository.
Use existing CI infrastructure (e.g., Jenkins or GitHub Actions) to resolve pipeline gaps.
assumptions: The developer has prior experience with Spring Cloud Data Flow, Spring Cloud Stream, and Spring XD.
A Hadoop/YARN test environment is available for testing the YARN deployer.
Access to the Maven repository for publishing OOTB modules is available.
Effort estimates include unit testing and local integration testing for each activity.
XD refers to Spring XD, the predecessor to Spring Cloud Data Flow.

activities.activity_description: Add a new shell command to list runtime details such as host, port, and module information for s-c-d users (U1).
Develop and integrate the capability to deploy data flows on YARN to leverage existing Hadoop clusters (U2).
Port the file module from Spring XD to the s-c-s repository to be used as a source module (U3).

activities.activity_name: Refactor Build Lifecycle for SPI Deployers
activities.activity_description: Break the build lifecycle to bundle SPI deployers individually, avoiding building admin with all deployer variations at once (U4).
Identify and remove XDRuntimeException from the codebase, replacing it with appropriate standard exceptions (U5).
Update the gemfire sink module to the latest release version for use in streaming pipelines (U6).
Implement, package, and list the SFTP source module as an OOTB module in the Maven repository (U7).
Fix and resolve remaining gaps in the CI pipelines for Data Flow and related projects to ensure continuous evaluation (U8).
Perform comprehensive integration and regression testing across all the implemented changes to ensure system stability.
